milestone: M46 Headless Mode Pack Update Continuation

strategic_capability_mapping.relationship: Lets headless.continue_once perform one authorized, replay-safe Mode Pack candidate approval step from M46.1 selected fetch and M46.2 selected provenance checkpoints.
Binds candidate approval to the registry-selected fetched candidate URL/content/policy/provenance/signer fingerprints already persisted by the Rust runtime.
Requires explicit headless continuation authorization and selected-candidate approval authorization, and fails closed before approval ledger mutation on stale or mismatched evidence.
Persists bounded approval continuation checkpoint evidence and replays without duplicating approval ledger events or exposing raw candidate/provenance material.

answers.strategic_capabilities: Advances headless_autonomous_development directly, with supporting progress for mode_pack_runtime, runtime_permission_enforcement, and persistent_structured_ledger.
answers.new_capability: headless.continue_once can approve one selected, fetched, provenance-verified Mode Pack candidate through existing approval authority and return bounded approval evidence plus explicit active replacement route.
answers.why_existing_functionality_is_insufficie: modepack.approveCandidate approves caller-supplied cached candidates, while M46.1 and M46.2 produce selected continuation evidence; no runtime-owned continuation previously bound selected fetch/provenance checkpoints to approval with fresh progress and active/selection revalidation.
answers.product_gap_if_skipped: Headless Mode Pack update pipelines remain stuck after selected provenance verification or depend on caller glue to approve candidates outside the continuation ledger.
answers.non_duplicative: Yes. M46.1 fetched selected candidates, M46.2 verified selected candidate provenance, and R6 hardened replay/selection integrity; M46.3 performs the next lifecycle mutation, selected verified candidate approval.
answers.no_new_rpc: Yes. This extends the existing headless.continue_once request/result shape and does not add a new RPC.
answers.no_new_summary: Yes. It uses existing ModePackApproveCandidateResult and bounded approval checkpoint metadata, not a report or digest wrapper.
answers.runtime_behavior_change: The Rust runtime validates fresh progress, explicit approval authorization, M46.1 fetch checkpoint, M46.2 provenance checkpoint, registry selection evidence, active snapshot identity, candidate/provenance/signer fingerprints, then performs one approval side effect and replays without duplicate approval evidence.
answers.headless_autonomous_contribution: Scheduled callers can advance from verified selected provenance to approved candidate trust state deterministically, with a next route to explicit active replacement.
answers.milestone_progress: Moves M46 from selected-candidate trust verification into selected candidate approval; active replacement remains the next continuation.

guard_engine_change_review.review_intent: M46.3 updates the deterministic current phase manifest and archives the M46.3 value gate. Review must confirm this is headless selected verified candidate approval execution, not a report/readiness wrapper.

exit_criteria: headless.continue_once accepts a bounded modepack_selected_candidate_approval_target with explicit authorization

runtime revalidates M46.1 fetch continuation id, fetch decision id, M46.2 provenance continuation id, provenance decision id, selection id/event id, candidate URL/content/policy fingerprints, provenance id/event id, statement URL/hash, signer fingerprint, and active activation fingerprint before approval mutation
runtime delegates to existing modepack.approveCandidate authority and returns bounded ModePackApproveCandidateResult
same-request replay returns bounded approval evidence and does not append duplicate ModePackCandidateApproved ledger events
same continuation id with mismatched approval request fingerprint rejects before replaying old evidence
VSIX protocol validators accept the approval target/result shape and reject raw fields
no new RPC, readiness/report/history/digest/inspection wrapper, automatic approval, active replacement, or VSIX-owned policy is added
behavior_evidence: Rust behavior test covers registry selection -> selected fetch continuation -> selected provenance verification continuation -> selected approval continuation success
Rust replay test covers no duplicate ModePackCandidateApproved event for same approval continuation request
Rust denial coverage includes mismatched approval request fingerprint and checkpoint/selection evidence validation
VSIX protocol tests validate the new bounded approval target/result shape and reject raw data fields
cargo fmt --check, cargo check --workspace, cargo test --workspace, pnpm guard:diagnostics, pnpm guard:phase-value, VSIX check/test/build, and git diff --check run before PR merge
